title: minuartia mutabilis var. atlantica
intro: Minuartia mutabilis var. atlantica, commonly known as Atlantic rockjasmine, is a plant species in the family Caryophyllaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, particularly for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Atlantic rockjasmine include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antifungal and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
